description.en: The code for the multicloud environment.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select the region of the Management Center based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of a member. This parameter allows an administrator to switch to the member's view.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The type of view. Valid values:

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem list-account-access-id --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
